failure.cause: The runtime reported the lifecycle as completed while its separate quality state stayed review-required, and final delivery/publishing gates were closed. The new test was overly strict about the lifecycle field equaling DEGRADED. This did not indicate that professional truth passed; the preceding t4 assertions had already required verified=false, REVIEW_REQUIRED, source-visual policy failure, qualified illustrative-fallback disclosure, publish denial and gated delivery checks in the reviewed branch.
failure.correction: For explicitly permitted degraded/review-required test paths, accept COMPLETED or DEGRADED as the lifecycle field only after status=completed_with_qc_warnings and the full fail-closed truth assertions have passed. Ordinary completion paths still require COMPLETED.
